reference: Signal-assisted audit of full waveforms, 256-sample spectrograms and 80-100 ms spectral bodies, inspected before model changes. Approximate acoustic onset times; no snapping or grid-derived timestamps. Labels infer acoustic drum intent; not independent human listening annotations. Every distinct burst retained; within-body retriggers and steady rumble excluded.
scope: Full untrimmed recordings: seven training sources and the reserved uptempo source. Development regression, not untouched-test accuracy.
